Maria Liu: quick handoff — paging noise earlier, root cause still being monitored but mitigations in place. leaving notes below, tagging @Ajay as primary for the next 8h.
Ajay Patel: thanks — taking primary. what’s the current customer impact? any ongoing pages?
Maria Liu: incident created by bot: INC-2026-1029 — transient 503 spike affecting inference-hosted in us-west for ~12m starting ~02:14 UTC. roughly 120k tokens failed across 3 customer orgs. we ran traffic split to dedicated model pool at 02:26 and applied KV cache eviction workarounds.
incidents-bot: Incident INC-2026-1029 created by monitoring-team. Severity: P2. Pager: @oncall. See https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2026-1029
Ajay Patel: got it. are we confident that the rollback to previous model variant is safe?
Maria Liu: yes — fallback to model-x-1.3 was validated on staging for perf and compatibility. we did canary for 10% traffic before full rollout. no errors from canary.
Jen Carter: quick note on coverage: Lia is APAC secondary but is offline for the next 2h (timezone overlap issue). I can be backup on evening shift if anything else pops.
Lia Gomez: I’m reachable via DM if needed but not on-call for active paging for next 2h.
Ajay Patel: coverage gap noted — @Jen can you be the secondary for the next 6h?
Jen Carter: yes, I’ll be secondary. also filing the follow-up ticket for root-cause analysis.
Maria Liu: action items for handoff: 1) monitor error rate and latency on /v1/generate and /v1/embed for us-west region (dashboard: infra/latency/us-west). 2) validate that KV cache eviction TTL is stable (see runbook snippet). 3) confirm no further regressions in model outputs for top 5 customers.
Jen Carter: filing follow-ups now: 
- TICKET: RINF-4567 (RCA + logs collection) 
- TICKET: RINF-4568 (customer comms draft)
Ajay Patel: thanks. can you also add the list of affected org IDs to RINF-4567? I’ll attach traces.
Jen Carter: will do. jotting down orgs: org-732, org-1145, org-2120.
Maria Liu: runbook pointer for mitigation (excerpt):
```
# KV cache eviction quick check
kubectl -n inference exec -it pod/inference-runtime-0 -- /bin/sh -c 'ls /var/cache/kv || echo no-cache'
# force eviction
curl -X POST https://runtime.local/admin/kv/evict?prefix=user:cache
# restart quick path for runtime shards (safe, non-disruptive)
kubectl -n inference rollout restart deployment/inference-runtime --timeout=120s
```
Ajay Patel: noted. I’m going to keep traces open and watch the auto-escalation rule for >5% error rate. If that fires, we rollback fully and re-route traffic to dedicated pool.
incidents-bot: Alert: error-rate > 3% threshold breached for 1 minute at 02:38 UTC (us-west).
Ajay Patel: saw that — spike to 3.6% but fell back after cache tweak. monitoring alert suppressed for now.
Lia Gomez: FYI, I ran a quick sim against model-x-1.3 and responses look good for the sample prompt set we keep. no hallucination regressions spotted.
Maria Liu: thanks Lia. post-handoff follow-ups: schedule a short retro for tomorrow 16:00 UTC, invite: infra, eng-runtime, product-sla, and solutions-eng. Jen to own comms + customer outreach draft. Ajay to own short-term monitoring playbook update. Maria to lead RCA ticket triage.
Jen Carter: retro scheduled: https://calendar.internal/event/retro-INC-2026-1029 — invite sent.
Ajay Patel: I’ll update the on-call runbook with the KV eviction step + the threshold tweak we used. Adding quick checklist to runbook page.
Maria Liu: final notes for next shift: primary = Ajay, secondary = Jen, backup = Lia (after 2h). no known ongoing customer-impacting pages now, but keep eyes open for latency regressions.
Ajay Patel: acknowledged. I’ll take watch and update if anything changes. typing up quick summary to paste into tickets.
Maria Liu: thanks team — handing off. :white_check_mark:
